summary: Tested 4-step NewPropertyModal + operazione persistence (backend) + Excel template/parse/commit. Found and fixed 2 regressions: (1) Excel parse was reading prezzo from cells[11] which is now 'Data acquisto' after Operazione column insertion — fixed to cells[12]; (2) NewPropertyModal step state was not re-syncing when preselectOperazione prop changed (modal stayed at step 1 when opened from Operazioni page) — added useEffect sync on open+preselect. All 8 backend tests pass; UI flow (4 steps, live preview, recap, toast, list-show, preselect→step 2 with blue accent) works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: NewPropertyModal.jsx (393 lines) is approaching the 700-line ceiling but still acceptable. Consider extracting the 4 step components into separate sub-files if it grows further.

imports.py parse function uses hard-coded cell index numbers (cells[11], cells[12]...). After this regression, recommend introducing named constants (IDX_OPERAZIONE=10, IDX_PREZZO=12, ...) or zipping cells with IMMOBILI_COLUMNS to avoid future off-by-one bugs when columns are inserted.

Empty-Operazione parse fallback currently always stores 'reddito' in the parse output (line 199-ish: `coerce_str(cells[10]) or 'reddito'`). The canone-based heuristic mentioned in the spec is only applied at commit time, which can confuse users seeing the parse preview. Consider applying the heuristic at parse time for UI consistency.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/property/NewPropertyModal.jsx (added useEffect to re-sync step+operazione when open/preselect changes)
seed_data_creation: None — test created 'TEST Flip Bologna' via UI and pytest cleanup removed it; demo IMM-BE20E5 and IMM-836DA0 untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Operazione-related flows are green after the two fixes. If new columns are added to the Excel template, double-check the cells[N] indices in imports.py parse_immobili — currently still position-based.
rca_of_the_issue: Regression 1 (prezzo wrong column): Inserting 'Operazione' at IMMOBILI_COLUMNS[10] shifted all subsequent columns by +1, but the parse function only updated some lookups (data_acquisto correctly stayed at cells[11], but `prezzo = cells[11]` was never bumped to cells[12]). Repro: upload Excel with Prezzo=150000 → parse returned prezzo_acquisto=0 (since data_acquisto string can't be coerced to float). Fix: change cells[11] → cells[12] for prezzo only. Regression 2 (preselect ignored on remount): `useState(preselectOperazione ? 2 : 1)` only runs on first mount; subsequent prop changes ignored. The modal in Operazioni page stayed mounted, so step never reset to 2. Fix: useEffect that watches [open, preselectOperazione] and resets step + form.operazione.
